answer: Perfect! All 126 tests now pass. The issue was in `shopcart/pricing.py:14` — the `bulk_discount` function was checking `qty > BULK_THRESHOLD` instead of `qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD`. This meant the discount wasn't being applied when the quantity exactly matched the threshold (10), which contradicted the docstring and the test expectations. Changing it to use `>=` fixed the issue.
